AXIOM_TOKEN.description: Axiom says to keep tokens confidential because anyone holding one can act on your behalf, sending data to your dataset among other things. A token can be regenerated in place, and Axiom suggests setting an expiry.

AXIOM_ORG_ID.description: Which organisation. An identifier that authenticates nothing on its own.

AXIOM_URL.description: An address, for a region other than the default.
